chat_decision_checkpoint.implementation_context: Gserver local G folder and current resident IPC contract

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
printf 'LOCAL_G_TOP_LEVEL:\n'
find /mnt/g -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | head -35
printf 'USERBOT_IPC_ACTION_REFERENCES:\n'
grep -nE 'ALLOWED|SUPPORTED|action[[:space:]]*==|action[[:space:]]+in|list.*channel|download.*video|video.*download|argparse|choices=' "$P/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$P/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" "$P/scripts/userbot_keepalive.py" 2>/dev/null | head -85 || true
printf 'USERBOT_SOCKET_LOCATIONS:\n'
find /run/user/"$(id -u)" /tmp -maxdepth 3 -type s -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'gace|userbot' | head -12 || true
